title: The Perfect Confession
author: Edmund Ravensworth
blurb: Mara Iversen, a retired detective running a failing bookshop, thought they had seen every way a life can end. But when twin letters arrive: one confessing, one promising more, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must find the witness everyone swears is dead before the tide gives up what it took.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
